releases.title: Club units, moderation replies, and student experience
releases.summary: Clubs can now model their real internal structure, feedback you send gets a reply, and schedules, collaboration, and Wrapped were reworked around how students actually use them.

changes.summary: Clubs can build their own internal units with unit-aware channel policies, and unit channels are created automatically.
Club managers can add authorized members directly instead of waiting for a join request.
Feedback you submit now notifies you when it is resolved, and dismissed feedback is archived rather than lost.
Schedules, collaboration, and Wrapped were reworked into one student experience pass.
Channels nest under their parent rows, workspace navigation is resizable, and the composer stays pinned to the bottom of the workspace.
Switching channels keeps the workspace mounted, so the club you are in no longer flashes on every jump.
Channel controls appear on hover, and club settings sections are visible instead of buried.
Role settings and structure editing are clearer to configure.
The mobile navigation drawer respects device safe areas.

Impersonation HTTP routes are disabled, and supervised impersonation is limited to authorized staff.
Custom themes are disabled in production while the editor is reviewed.
